title: Derivation rules
description: The rules that turn scored coverage into a role and an archetype. Role and archetype are computed from these, never assigned per tool. Structural rules only; the validator checks that every capability resolves to a role.

roles.description: The closed role vocabulary, in tie-break order: when two roles score equally the earlier one wins. Must match the role enum in tool.schema.json.

band_weight.description: How much a band capability counts toward a role, relative to 1 for a spine capability. Below 1 so a tool's pipeline job outweighs its cross-cutting extras.

role_affinity.description: Capability -> the role it suggests. An exact capability ID beats a <stage-or-band>.* pattern. Every capability must resolve to a role.

archetype.description: Thresholds on level-3 spine coverage. specialist: at most specialist_max_stages stages and specialist_max_capabilities capabilities. end-to-end: at least end_to_end_min_stages stages. Anything between is a stage-platform.

match.description: An exact capability ID, or <stage-or-band>.* for every capability under it.
